rows.requirement: Free or replace the stuck bathtub waste-and-overflow trip lever without destroying the concealed plumbing.

rows.requirement: Restore a stopper that seals when closed and a drain that runs freely when open.
rows.basis: Functional acceptance control; Watco instructions include a fill/operate test for its models.
rows.acceptance_check: Fill, close, open and leak-test; record results before closing any opening.

rows.requirement: Obtain photographs of the tub, overflow plate, access area and ceiling below before finalizing scope.
rows.basis: No photographs were supplied in the repository; description-based analysis is limited.

rows.legacy_ids: root R-04/R-25; bt R-S05; data REQ-24/27

rows.requirement: Identify the actual waste-and-overflow brand/model, drain size and whether a compatible kit exists.
rows.basis: Existing assembly is unknown; model-specific instructions cannot be assumed to fit.
rows.acceptance_check: Provider records model/size and compatibility before ordering parts.

rows.requirement: Prefer removal from above through the overflow opening if it can be done safely without damaging concealed piping.
rows.basis: Owner preference; Watco shows a tub-side service path for its models.
rows.acceptance_check: Provider attempts/documents the non-destructive route before cutting finished surfaces.

rows.requirement: Use below-ceiling access through the storage unit only if the above route fails or is judged unsafe.
rows.basis: Owner-reported fallback; Heise’s publishes an adjacent ceiling-access case.
rows.acceptance_check: Written access decision names the opening location, size and restoration plan.
rows.legacy_ids: root R-06/R-07; bt R-A01; data REQ-05

rows.requirement: Confirm ownership, authority and consent to enter/open the storage unit or separate space below.
rows.basis: Access may involve a different tenant, owner or common area.
rows.acceptance_check: Written authorization and affected-party notice are in the job file.

rows.requirement: Consider a code-compliant serviceable access panel rather than burying slip-joint connections again.
rows.basis: Access-panel dimensions could not be verified from a free official code source; do not assert a fixed 12-inch rule.
rows.acceptance_check: Contractor/DBI specifies the required access solution and dimensions in writing.

rows.requirement: Adjust the linkage first if serviceable; replace the waste-and-overflow assembly if it cannot be freed.
rows.basis: Owner estimates describe different scopes; manufacturer instructions are model-specific.
rows.acceptance_check: Written scope distinguishes adjustment, linkage replacement and full assembly replacement.

rows.requirement: Clarify whether “spout/diverter” means the tub waste-and-overflow or a separate tub-fill diverter.
rows.basis: Bay Area Plumbing wording is not automatically equivalent to waste-and-overflow replacement.
rows.acceptance_check: Annotated scope identifies each part to be repaired/replaced.

rows.requirement: Protect existing concealed supply, waste and vent piping; price any unavoidable cutting/replacement separately.
rows.basis: Owner preservation requirement; DBI permit rule applies to cutting/replacing pipes.
rows.acceptance_check: Change order identifies affected piping, permit/inspection path and price before extra work.

rows.requirement: Restore drywall, tape, texture and paint to an agreed finish after any ceiling opening.
rows.basis: C-9 defines drywall/finishing scope; no supplied quote explicitly names restoration.
rows.acceptance_check: Contract names the restoration party, finish standard and access-panel/patch choice.
rows.legacy_ids: root R-08/R-12; bt R-S04; data REQ-07

rows.requirement: Protect floors/fixtures and stored contents, contain dust, remove debris and leave the space clean/secure each day.
rows.basis: Occupied-unit control; CSLB contract guidance includes cleanup.
rows.acceptance_check: Daily cleanup/protection checklist and final walkthrough are agreed.

rows.requirement: Use a currently licensed plumbing contractor for the plumbing leg and verify the legal contracting entity.
rows.basis: C-36 defines plumbing scope; CSLB records are point-in-time.
rows.acceptance_check: CSLB number, legal name, status and classifications match the contract on signing day.
rows.legacy_ids: root R-13/R-14; bt R-L01/R-L05; data REQ-08/09

rows.requirement: Structure the combined contract lawfully: B prime with appropriate trades, or named licensed specialty subcontractors.

rows.requirement: Recheck license status, bond, workers-compensation record and complaint-disclosure links before signing.

rows.acceptance_check: Signing-day CSLB screenshot/link and any disclosure review are retained.

rows.requirement: Obtain current general-liability evidence and workers-compensation evidence for every onsite party.
rows.basis: CSLB workers-comp “exempt” means certified no employees, not general liability coverage.
rows.acceptance_check: Certificates name the contracting entity and cover the work date; subcontractors are included.

rows.requirement: Confirm the provider actually serves the San Francisco address and accepts a small occupied-unit repair.

rows.requirement: Ask for specific waste-and-overflow/trip-lever references, ideally below-ceiling access in an occupied unit.

rows.acceptance_check: References/photos identify the actual scope, access route and restoration party.

rows.requirement: Check third-party reviews, but treat blocked/search-index observations as unverified leads.

rows.acceptance_check: Review links and retrieval limits are recorded; no rating is presented as verified.

rows.requirement: Prefer a provider that states it coordinates with landlords/property managers and occupied properties.
rows.basis: Company self-descriptions and older review excerpts are leads, not current protocols.
rows.acceptance_check: Provider supplies a written occupied-unit plan and tenant contact protocol.

rows.requirement: If a permit is required, use the appropriate licensed contractor and PermitSF route.

rows.requirement: Schedule required plumbing inspection before pipes or openings are covered.

rows.requirement: Obtain a written itemized contract covering plumbing, access, restoration, permits, cleanup, schedule, price and warranty.
